---
title: "New Autonomous Planning Agent"
product: "DataAgent"
product_code: "dataagent"
source: "https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/dataagent/New_Autonomous_Planning_Agent"
---

The agent center supports self\-built agents with autonomous planning capabilities. You can modify the configuration information of the agent, generate the call address and key of the agent, and then make calls to external systems through API. The types of agents currently supported for creation include:

* **Thinking\-Action Agent**

   Interlaced thinking (reasoning) \- action (think and act step by step), the React architecture. And continuously adjust the follow\-up execution strategy according to the action feedback. It is suitable for scenarios with few tools, flexible processes, real\-time feedback, and no complex planning.

   ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

* **Planning\-Action Agent**

   Generate a complete execution plan first, and then follows the planning steps. The whole process is guided by a "clear planning path", that is, Rewoo architecture. It is suitable for complex tasks with multi\-tool collaboration, clear goals, and high process integrity requirements.

   ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

# New Agent

1. Log into the Marketing Agent console and, at the top of the left navigation bar, select **Marketing Interactive Assistant**.

2. Select **Agent Center** in the left navigation bar of Marketing Interactive Assistant, and click **New Agent** in the upper right corner of the page.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3246e0086f42490e8999166578c062e2~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

3. Hover over the specified agent type and click **New**.

   Different agent type configuration items are different, please refer to [Think-Action Agent Configuration Item](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/New_Autonomous_Planning_Agent#4fadb296), [Planning - Mobile Agent Configuration Items](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/New_Autonomous_Planning_Agent#54e86e41).

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/235b6bcc7f514d609ae2221dad740b0d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

## Configure Assistant

All kinds of agents provide configuration assistants. After entering the agent orchestration page, you can describe the agent configuration goals in natural language, and the assistant intelligence will help you initialize and tune the agent configuration.

1. Click on the avatar in the upper left corner of the agent orchestration page.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/1159a10949b349d19c450210b32b6cdf~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

2. Targets are configured with natural language input agents and support for associating knowledge bases, adding tools, or uploading attachments.

   The assistant will automatically synchronize the configuration and support debug preview verification effects.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/93dff031b194405c84080203e5298069~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

Click the + icon to add three types of knowledge: term base, QA question and answer base, and general knowledge base, which can be used as additional information input when the agent executes to help the agent better generate answers. Multiple knowledge bases of each type can be added. The creation of the knowledge base can refer to the enterprise knowledge engine [Create a New Knowledge Base](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/undefined/69e591f8ad0646055cc24c72). |
|Memory |Memory allows users to configure their conversation rounds, short\-term memory, and long\-term memory on demand.<br><br><br>* **Short\-term memory:**  On means that the original text of the historical session and the overview of the historical session are given to the agent as context input.<br><br>   * **Number of dialogue rounds:**  The number of context rounds recalled when intent recognition is rolled, and the context dialogue information is used as supplementary information during query rewriting and intent recognition.<br><br>* **Long\-term memory:**  Automatically retrieve records of user portraits, preferences, and events.<br><br>   * **Memory:**  Specifies the memory currently required from the session memory.<br><br>   * **Memory usage rules:**  support multiple selection<br><br>      * **Read Memory:**  Allows the agent to read historical memories in this memory bank.<br><br>      * **Write Global Shared Memory:**  Allows the agent to precipitate the content of this conversation into a global generic portrait memory/event memory.<br><br>      * **Write to agent memory:**  Allows the agent to precipitate the content of this conversation into a memory only for the current agent. After selecting this rule, you need to specify a memory retrieval policy. |
|Voice interaction |The voice interaction includes the following two function switches, which can be turned on as needed.<br><br><br>* **Speech to text:**  When turned on, users can interact with the agent via voice input.<br><br>* **Text To Speech:**  When turned on, the agent replies to support conversion to voice playback.<br><br>   * Support custom timbre.<br><br>   * Support enabling default automatic broadcast.<br><br><br>If the API Key parameter is missing or invalid, please contact the enterprise super administrator to configure the parameters required for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and Text To Speech (TTS).<br><br>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4cc13b7d365e4b898bd942942c27f655~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
|Dialog configuration |* **Opening remarks:**  The fixed guide content of the opening remarks.<br><br>* **Opener question:**  Configure the fixed question of opener guide, add up to 5.<br><br>* **Dialogue guide question:**  closed by default, the dialogue guide question is the related question after the answer output. Output rules can be configured by prompts.<br><br>* **Prompt:**  Fixed prompt that can be configured to appear before or after the answer output. It is usually displayed as a risk warning after the answer is output.<br><br>* **Citation display:**  used to set the way to display the quoted information in the answer, support selection **close**, **body annotation and source list**, **only source list**.<br><br>* **Feedback label:**  After opening, support the like and step function, and support the configuration of like labels and click labels. For example, after liking, it is supported to select the forward label for feedback.<br><br>   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/76d22e2f1f1f4aa688980abad6134875~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) |
|Lifecycle Dynamic Function |An open code node, which can input the rule requirements of the agent before execution, before thinking, after thinking, before planning, during planning, and after planning |
|Streaming output filter function |The middleware code framework for streaming output, the framework guarantees that each chunk will pass through two of the hooks, where you can decide it "release/replace/discard", and can do cumulative state processing across chunks by `custom_context`. |
|Security policy configuration |Support BytePlus [large model application firewall ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84990/1520619)function to ensure that the model input and output content is safe, available and trusted.<br><br><br>* How to obtain parameter configuration information such as AK, SK, server address, firewall ID, region, etc., please refer to the [description of key parameters of large model application firewall](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84990/1827490?lang=zh#438128ee).<br><br>* **Whether to verify the request content:**  After opening, the request content will be verified for security compliance.<br><br>* **Whether to verify LLM output:**  After opening, the large model output will be verified for security compliance.<br><br>* **Hit risk control prompt:** <br><br>   * **Content generation using security services:**  Prompts are generated using the internal capabilities of a large model application firewall.<br><br>   * **Use a custom security prompt:**  You need a custom prompt in the input box. |
|Timeout and limited viewership of |* **Speed Limit Configuration:**  The maximum number of requests per second (or minute), the default is null to indicate no limit.<br><br>* **Error code:**  The error code returned when the limit viewership is reached, the default is 429.<br><br>* **Error message:**  The prompt message returned when the limit viewership is reached, the default is "There are too many visitors at present, please try again later".<br><br>* **Sub\-agent timeout time:**  Set the timeout time of calling the downstream sub\-agent, in seconds. |

# Debugging agent

After completing the configuration of the agent, enter the problem in the **Debug and Preview** dialog box on the right side of the agent editing page to debug.

![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/518732ee91904f8ea1b8b44c2f5b6de1~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

* If the **multi\-modal recognition capability** is enabled, the upload of picture attachments is supported, and up to 5 pictures can be uploaded at a time, and the picture size cannot exceed 20 MB.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e64e43e8d3b844d2acd4987a32000167~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

* If the **speech to text** ability of **voice interaction** is turned on, voice input is supported.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/57eca3d0f70340a1b02f4deedd000130~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

# Save and publish agents

Once debugging is complete, select **Save** or **Save and Publish** in the upper right corner of the page.

![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e64f03ffc99144f8be0226d474fcc62c~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

* **Save:**  Save only the configuration information of the current agent, but do not publish the agent. In the Agent Center list, the current agent is in an **unpublished** state.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/57a923a926d045069b0b1981cbae04f0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

* **Save and publish:**

   1. In the release pop\-up window, confirm the version number information (the first version number is V1), and add a version description.

      ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9f48b3117c02463ab72c5693ed7a553d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

   2. After successful publication, the current intent planning engine is in the **published** state in the Agent Center list.

      ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/0a174968939f4704ad6ef2324edfc15e~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

      Supports publishing or unpublishing agents in agent cards.

      ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b48b87dc74d94d29b193ea2c9e07ed60~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

# Version management

Agents generate a version every time they save a release. You can choose to enter an agent details page in the agent center, and click the version in the upper right corner of the details page to view the agent's version record.

* **Draft version:**  The unpublished version that is currently being edited.

* **Online version:**  The version that has saved the configuration and has been published.

![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/16e300a118c44e1c98f87af1b12f79fb~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

After switching to the historical version, it supports rolling back the historical version data through the duplicate function.

![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/f04e7769f8a34c749cc8611501b6ba65~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

# Edit/Copy/Delete Agent

In the list of agent centers, select the specified card to support the following operations:

* **Edit:**  Enter the agent details page, support modifying the configuration of the agent, and debug the agent.

* **Replication:**  Quickly replicate a new agent based on the current agent's configuration, and support adjusting each configuration item during replication.

* **Deletion:**  Agents that are no longer needed support deletion.

> **注意**

> Once the agent is deleted, it cannot be restored, please operate with caution.

![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/db18dd6722c745f284847686829d3ef0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

# Add tags to the agent

1. On the agent card, it supports adding labels to classify agents.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/14550a225cb84205b022886d8c896be2~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

2. Agents within the specified range can then be filtered through labels.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b7d37860990a48e7b1853db510f69055~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

# Get Agent API

The released agent supports API access to the downstream business platform, allowing platform users to use the agent's intelligent Q&A function.

1. In the Agent Center list, check Specify a published card and click **API address** on the card.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9ba73bae12ac4d33bfa81ea3bc04b12e~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

2. In the publish API pop\-up window, you can obtain the API address and API key for accessing the downstream business platform.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/d763284f637048e498c567c5b1f8ee9d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)

   You can also click **Preview** to debug whether the intelligent Q&A capability of the current agent is as expected.

   ![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/340ccdad3a7b4113a75803e2f9603d24~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
